what_each_new_part_touches: Sub-steps 1-5: blue pins go through the 11-hole beam, a 5-hole beam is placed on two of them, small pins join, the 7-hole beam is pressed on, and another 5-hole beam closes the stack. The finished stack is fitted to the model on page 118 (arrow with green guide lines).
where_everything_is_after: a long layered black beam stack with blue pins is ready for the roof

why.problem_solved: Builds the roof support: layered beams make a stiff bar.

review_note: Five sub-steps; pin counts per sub-step follow the box (3 blue, 3 dark). The 4-hole beam is read from the icon.
